package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"sync"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_async_concurrency_mutex_held_during_slow_call: Layer: Async and concurrency. Flag mutex-protected regions that include network, disk, or database calls.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

var cache507 = make(map[string][]byte)
var mu507 sync.Mutex

func scenario507Positive(url string) ([]byte, error) {
	mu507.Lock()
	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		mu507.Unlock()
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	mu507.Unlock()
	return nil, nil
}
